svg.text: A dead king walks the battlements at night;
the watch brings Horatio out to see it
▸ THE HOOK — the dead king is walking
Claudius takes the throne and the widow;
Hamlet keeps his black and his silence
▸ THE NEW ORDER — an uncle on the throne
Laertes warns his sister off Hamlet;
their father orders her to end it
▸ THE HOUSE — a brother and a father close a
His father's ghost says he was murdered by
the brother who took the crown and the wife
▸ THE CHARGE — a son is handed a murder
Ophelia reports a visit, his clothes undone;
the court decides the cause is love
▸ THE ALARM — the court reads him as lovesick
With the king and her father listening,
Hamlet tells Ophelia to go to a nunnery
▸ THE TURN — he sends her away and means it
Actors stage a murder like his father's;
the king gets up and calls for light
▸ THE TRAP — the guilty one shows himself
Hamlet finds the king alone and kneeling,
and does not do it — the one chance he gets
▸ THE SPARING — a sword put away, once
His sword goes through the curtain and finds
▸ THE KILLING — the wrong man behind the arras
Ophelia sings and hands out flowers;
her brother breaks in with a mob
▸ THE ANGER — a brother comes home for blood
Gertrude reports the willow and the water;
the king and Laertes agree on a sharp foil
▸ THE ENDGAME — a duel, a cup, and no way back
Hamlet fences Laertes while the court watches;
the foil and the cup are both poisoned
▸ THE MATCH — a fight he does not know is fixed
The queen drinks the cup, the king is stabbed,
and Hamlet dies in Horatio's arms
▸ THE FLOOR — four die; Fortinbras takes
LANES — label size follows strand width
13 beats, 8 lanes. A play — the anchors are acts and scenes, not minutes.
Row spacing widens before the coda — time passes there.
A play in five acts: each beat is anchored to an act and a scene, not to a minute mark.
Row spacing widens before the coda — the last beat is four deaths.
